summary: Work Orders – Status filter resets after switching tabs
reported_issue: Filtering Work Orders by Status (By Status tab) and then switching to another tab and back resets the status filter to default, forcing the user to reapply it.
expected_after_fix: The selected Status filters should remain applied even after navigating away from the page and returning.
steps_i_followed: Clicked the 'By Status' tab which reveals the status multi-select (default label 'All Statuses').
Opened the multi-select and selected 'Approved' and 'Complete' — label changed to 'Selected Statuses'.
Switched to the 'Work Orders' sub-tab, then back to 'By Status' — checked the select value.
Navigated fully away to /schedule, then back to /workorders — checked active tab and select value.
actual_now: After selecting statuses the By Status select shows 'Selected Statuses'. After a sub-tab roundtrip (Work Orders -> By Status) the value is still 'Selected Statuses'. After full navigation to /schedule and back to /workorders, the active tab is still 'By Status' and the select still shows 'Selected Statuses'. The filter selection persists.
notes: Verified both the sub-tab switch (Estimates/Work Orders/By Status) and a full route navigation away and back. Filter state is retained in both cases, matching expected_after_fix.
